about: Judged proposal deduplication (Jev use 3, decisions). Each item is one proposal and the existing records it is checked against; `duplicateOf` is the judged match, or null for a novel proposal (dropping that is the costly error); `kind` the case (exact: the local rules catch it, reworded: the same item in other words, related: a separate step, person, site or value, novel). Synthetic. Outputs per arm: verdict new | possible | duplicate, and of (an existing id or null).
